# Main Analysis: Results






```{r Load packages and results of descriptive analysis, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Load required packages
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)


## Load results
load("../data/Rsession_analysis_main2026-02-02.RData")

```

<br><br><br><br>

## 1.

Unadjusted Kaplan-Meier curves stratified by the three treatment groups (The SAP reads: "A Kaplan-Meier plot stratified by the three treatment groups will be created". Since there was no mention of "adjusted" or "IPTW-weighted", I figured that the unadjusted KM curves were desired).

```{r print Figure 4, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


## Print result
print(Fig4)

```


<br><br><br><br>

## 2.

Distribution of weights calculated from multinomial logistic regression model:

```{r print Figure 5 and 6, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


## Print result
print(Fig5)
print(Fig6)


```

Interpretation of weights: They seem to be fine; i.e. there are no huge outliers due to extremely low estimated probabilities.


<br><br><br><br>

## 3.


Assessment of PH assumption via Schoenfeld residuals of Cox model:


```{r Print Figure 1, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

## Print results
res <- print(survival::cox.zph(coxph_drugs_weighted))

```


There is no indication of a violation of the proportional hazards assumption.


<br><br><br><br>
